# 100X ENERGY EFFICIENT COMPUTE FOR AI.

Mythic's analog compute-in-memory architecture delivers 100x greater efficiency. The APU (Analog Processing Unit) is purpose-built for a world that can't afford to keep powering AI the old way.

## A new architecture that rewrites the rules of what's possible.

Mythic’s TECHNOLOGY

Traditional chips shuttle data between processor and memory billions of times per second, burning most of their energy on movement, not computation. It's an 80-year-old architectural flaw the industry never stopped to question. Mythic did. We store AI model weights inside flash memory and compute in analog, directly at the source, eliminating the waste at its origin.
